Evidence conflicts: cache headers suggest liveness, but the TLS certificate proves the content being served for that SNI does not correspond to the organisation. search_queries_used: Entertainment One UK Limited website eOne Hasbro Lionsgate 2026
search_findings_summary: Well-documented corporate history from SEC filings and trade press: Hasbro acquired Entertainment One in 2021, wound down eOne UK's theatrical division in July 2023, then sold eOne's entertainment assets to Lionsgate for $500m, completing 26 December 2023; eOne UK's remaining operations were folded into the Lionsgate Studios structure through 2024. This is a clear, multiply-corroborated acquisition with a named successor (Lionsgate).
live_verification: entertainmentone.co.uk failed to connect (timeout, both http/https). entertainmentone.com resolves and returns HTTP 200 but with an essentially empty 94-byte placeholder page (no real content) - not a genuine live corporate site, so it was not used as a candidate. lionsgate.com was separately confirmed live (HTTP 200, valid Lionsgate-branded HTML) as the acquiring successor's site, but that is Lionsgate's own domain, not a rename of Entertainment One UK Limited itself, so it is not proposed as this organisation's canonical domain.
